def factor_range_pressure_vol_asymmetry(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    volume = df_copy["volume"]
    # primary mechanism: cycle range pressure over 60 days
    buy_pressure = (close - df_copy["low"]).rolling(60, min_periods=20).sum()
    sell_pressure = (df_copy["high"] - close).rolling(60, min_periods=20).sum()
    total_range = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]).rolling(60, min_periods=20).sum()
    range_pressure = (buy_pressure - sell_pressure) / total_range.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    # lightweight modifier from tail-skew-volume parent: downside volume participation
    ret = close.pct_change()
    down_vol = volume.where(ret < 0, 0.0).rolling(60, min_periods=30).sum()
    total_vol = volume.rolling(60, min_periods=30).sum().replace(0.0, np.nan)
    down_ratio = down_vol / total_vol
    # attenuate range pressure when downside volume dominates
    factor = range_pressure * (1.0 - down_ratio)
    df_copy["factor_range_pressure_vol_asymmetry"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_range_pressure_vol_asymmetry"]
description: Preserves the primary cycle-range-pressure mechanism from market_cycle_0002, which identifies accumulation/distribution phase by the position of closes within the trailing 60-day high-low range. Borrows the lightweight downside-volume-participation modifier from acp_gen0_b_tail_skew_volume_asymmetry: when downside volume dominates, the range-pressure signal is attenuated, reflecting reduced reliability of the cycle phase during distribution-heavy periods. This single coherent interaction targets improved RankIC and MI without mutating the core economics, keeping cross-sectional transform 'none' to preserve raw payoff structure.
